title: Pilots seeing UAP at Lemoore, Fallon and Pax River
summary: Ryan Graves tells of Pilots seeing UAP at Lemoore, Fallon and Pax River, about not stated at Norfolk/Virginia Beach, the California coast, Lemoore, Fallon, Pax River, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Norfolk/Virginia Beach, the California coast, Lemoore, Fallon, Pax River

tellings.quote: Um, further inland, Lore, Fallon, these are other, you know, big Navy training ranges. They're seeing them there. Uh, Pax River where we do our test pilot training. Uh, they're having incidents up there.

plain: A former Navy fighter pilot, Ryan Graves, says that pilots are seeing UAP, meaning unexplained objects in the sky, not just off the coasts of Virginia and California but also further inland. He names Lemoore and Fallon, which he describes as big Navy training ranges, and Pax River, where the Navy trains its test pilots, saying they are having incidents there too. If true, it would mean these objects are showing up across many military training areas, not just one place.
